sources.summary: Ads section explicitly introduces items 4-8 as applying to ad buying solutions. Item 7 restricts cross-platform advertising-data mixing unless product terms permit it. Item 6 transparency changes are effective 2027-02-03, after this check date. Reporting-only status is not an automatic exemption from Platform Terms or permission-specific policies.
Specific exceptions concern Messenger communication, lead-form data and Shops user-provided data. A Shopify merchant/catalog does not automatically make Marketing API insights Shops User Data.
Linked current restricted-data definition has category exceptions. This review does not infer classification of every current permission or waive general Platform Data obligations.

Official Insights documentation describes performance reporting, requires ads_read, and directs reporting solutions to Platform Terms and Marketing API Developer Policies. Technical read access is not proof of permission to combine publishers' reporting.

Competitor aggregated offerings/views and competitor-data aggregation require explicit Klaviyo written permission. The wording does not say every other platform. Express account-owner permission, security, privacy and deletion duties also apply.

Partner agreement incorporates API Terms, provides application/review/acceptance procedures and document precedence when terms conflict. Partner membership or omission of an older restriction is not by itself an explicit written waiver.

provider_questions_prepared_not_sent.question: AdsTable is a reporting-only Shopify embedded application. Each merchant explicitly authorizes access to their own advertising account; AdsTable does not buy ads, create/manage campaigns, retarget, or share one merchant's data with another. It plans to show that merchant's Meta, Google Ads and Klaviyo metrics in a reporting product, preserving source attribution. Does Developer Policies section 10 item 7 apply to this reporting-only use case, and what product-term permission or review approval, if any, is required for the proposed combined reporting?

AdsTable is a merchant-authorized reporting application, not an email/SMS delivery or campaign-automation service. It plans to show one merchant's Klaviyo campaign/flow performance alongside that same merchant's Google Ads and Meta advertising metrics, preserving source attribution and tenant isolation. Do API Terms restrictions (v) and (vi) apply to this use case? If so, please confirm the explicit written permission or agreement provision required for AdsTable.
